name: MathTutorBench
description: MathTutorBench is an open-source benchmark designed to evaluate the pedagogical capabilities of AI tutoring models through dialog-based teaching tasks. It includes datasets and metrics to assess tutoring quality, including a reward model trained to distinguish expert from novice teacher responses.
reputation: A recent open-source benchmark for AI tutoring quality that is still emerging and has limited community adoption so far.
notes: Includes a reward model for scoring pedagogical quality; released with code and leaderboard for ongoing benchmarking.
